bio.text: Evan Hunt is a Democratic candidate for Congress in Texas's 3rd District, according to his campaign website, which says he lives in McKinney with his family.

The campaign website says he is a retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel who served as a B-1 bomber weapons systems officer, later served in the Air National Guard and retired in 2022, and has since held executive roles in the defense and aerospace industry.
It says he has a bachelor's degree from the University of Pennsylvania and a master's degree in international relations and conflict resolution from American Military University.
